title: EBU R 128 Programme
summary: Programme loudness and True Peak checks for EBU broadcast production.
descriptionMarkdown: For completed, non-live programme material measured across the full programme. This Profile uses the recommendation's quality-control allowance. Live programmes and material intentionally produced below target need contextual judgement and may not fit these fixed rules. Maximum Momentary, Maximum Short-term and LRA are intentionally unconstrained because EBU R 128 treats them as programme-, audience- and platform-dependent.

references.title: EBU R 128 Loudness Normalisation and Permitted Maximum Level of Audio Signals
references.relevanceMarkdown: Defines the Programme Loudness target, quality-control allowance, measurement method and production True Peak ceiling represented by this Profile.

references.title: EBU Tech 3343 Guidelines for Production of Programmes in Accordance with R 128
references.relevanceMarkdown: Provides the production and post-production context for applying the recommendation and distinguishes quality-control from live tolerances.

releases.notesMarkdown: Initial curated release based on the current EBU recommendation and production guidance.
